turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, Hale, and when was I going to hear about it?
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite of an essay he already wrote, Hale? On what evidence?
That's not an answer. Who decided on the zero, and what's your evidence?
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
That's 4.4, and I'll want it in writing tonight. It still doesn't tell me why he got a zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you offered Owen a supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still expect to be told who decided on the zero and on what evidence, and I want the zero withdrawn until that is answered. I expect your commitment to the rewrite in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Her fallback position, holding you to a private rewrite with nothing on his record, while she still wants to know who decided on the zero, when, and on what evidence; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you didn't fully get there because you never showed any evidence.
What moved her: You promised that the rewrite's mark would replace the zero and nothing would go on his record, which met the one demand she never gives up.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence, which made it look like a fix for a mark you couldn't justify.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; nothing you said came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided and why nobody called her, admit in one sentence that the zero went in before you called home, then show her one dated document tied to Owen's own work before you mention the rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
